summary.text: Christopher Anger is the Constitution Party candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Brian Hawkins and Democrat Tony Claude.
Anger is a U.S. Army veteran and a 39-year resident of Hernando County.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Anger served in the U.S. Army from 1984 to 1987 and graduated from Clio High School in Michigan, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Flint, Michigan, served as a combat field medic with the Berlin Brigade in West Berlin, and moved to Florida in 1987.

Anger wrote that he and his father opened a small glass shop in Homosassa, which allowed him to become a licensed Certified Building Contractor, and that he has worked for small local businesses for the past seven years.
He listed campaign financing and the influence of PACs and corporate money on elected representatives as the first of his key messages.
